messages.author: 3c04c342136fe2e7
messages.subject: Wrapping up GSoC/R 2010 write-up
parts:
Dear GSoC students and mentors,

We should report the final status to the R community, GSoC and the world at
large. So at long last and a little belatedly, I just sat down and wrote up a
page based on the form used by Fritz and Manuel in 2008 and 2009. Please see

http://dirk.eddelbuettel.com/tmp-r/soc10.html

Please read the draft page, and in particular 'your' paragraphs. This is
old-school html, so just use 'view source' and send me diffs or new paragraphs
when something is amiss. I am sure I have misspelled a thing or two and
won't vouch for grammar or correctness either.

I would like to post this early next week. So if you have a chance to review
this over the weekend or on Monday, I would greatly appreciate it.

Thanks also to the three our of four who have uploaded to the Google Code
site. If you haven't you know who you are and what we expect from you :)

Comments, criticism, corrections -- keep'em coming.

Cheers, Dirk

--
Dirk Eddelbuettel | e...@debian.org | http://dirk.eddelbuettel.com

messages.author: ec32e5a92a275a89
messages.subject: Re: Wrapping up GSoC/R 2010 write-up
parts:
THanks for putting this together. Only change suggested is from 'rdx' to 'radx'. I'm a bit
sensitive to the name Chillu originally chose: my mother was <100m from 880kg of rdx when
it went off in August 1944 and, we believe, died young in part due to injuries sustained.
I suspect there may be other people who have bad associations with the rdx name as well.

On other matters, has Google provided a PO yet for us? I don't need to claim until after,
but it would be good to know things are in place. I presume they want receipts etc., which
I"m used to providing.

Best,

JN
